High-quality photograph by Liat Portal showing orange cauliflower florets, white onion, red onion, potato, sweet potato, and garlic roasted together in the oven with olive oil, salt, and pepper. This image demonstrates cooking by time rather than skill, where heat and duration replace technique. It supports cooking by budget and limited ingredient variety, showing how accessible vegetables can form a complete meal. It reflects plant-based everyday cooking as a cultural and lifestyle choice, aligning with contemporary vegan-oriented public figures such as Jared Leto without relying on performance or specialization.
